message:
test(ka-pc r4): test hosts with --input-injection-mode none (the verifier's standard), not --config

Codex decided the standard for every test host: an explicit --input-injection-mode none on the argv, and no viewer
before this launch says 'input injection disabled'. The --config variant is dropped: a config file clears the
host's environment overrides (json_profile.hpp clear_runtime_env_overrides), the h264 switch among them -- r4-2
measured the host leaving at once with 'unsupported codec: h264' (fail-closed: no viewer connected).
